content.title: Today, an Opportunity to Become Better
content.subtitle: This dream is not only Muslims Day's, but all of ours.
content.body:
Small changes every day

Today, perhaps a young man will sit down with the Qur'an again after a long time. A mother will teach her child a new du'a. Someone will hear the Fajr Adhan and stand up. Someone will make dhikr a part of their life once again. It is these small acts of worship that gradually make a person a better Muslim today than they were yesterday.

This is exactly the dream of Muslims Day—to become a trusted companion in that journey for millions of people every day.

A mission that belongs to the Ummah

Every day, through research, new features, improving the user experience, and creating authentic Islamic content, we are striving to transform technology into a medium that helps people come closer to Allah.

As part of this mission, the Ansar Special Webinar—"Productive Muslim: Why, What and How?"—will be held today.

Because we believe that the one who strives every day to become a better Muslim is also the one who can contribute most beautifully to helping others become better.

How Can You Join?

  1. If you are a Muslims Day Ansar: You will be able to participate in the session live via Zoom and have the opportunity to join the special Q&A session with the speaker. If you have already completed your registration, the Zoom link will be sent to your email address, In shaa Allah.

  2. If you are not an Ansar: There is no need to worry. In shaa Allah, the entire session will be broadcast live on the Muslims Day Facebook Page. Therefore, this important discussion will be open to everyone.

An intention that will remain even after you

If you would like a portion of your ability every month to be connected to a mission that brings people closer to the Qur'an every day, reminds them of worship, and makes it easier to walk on the path of Allah, then you are warmly invited to join this journey as a Muslims Day Ansar.

Perhaps your intention today will, by the will of Allah, become a silent companion in helping many people become better Muslims. If Allah accepts it, your participation in this ongoing goodness may become a means of Sadaqah Jariyah, In shaa Allah.
